## Load libraries

```{r}
#| message: false 
#| warning: false 
library("here")
library("tidyverse")
library("table1")
```

## Load data

```{r}
data_dir <- here("data")  

describe_df <- readr::read_tsv(file = file.path(data_dir,
                                                "03_dat_aug.tsv.gz"),
                               col_names = TRUE,
                               show_col_types = FALSE)
```

### Workaround for age_at_diagnosis

```{r}
describe_df <- describe_df |>
  mutate(age_years = round(age_at_diagnosis / 365.25,
                                  digits = 1))
```

## Dataset overview

```{r}
n_samples <- n_distinct(describe_df$sample_id)
n_genes <- n_distinct(describe_df$gene_id)
```

Our data set have `r n_samples` and each sample contains expression values of `r n_genes` gene isoforms.

### NA values

```{r}
describe_df |>
  distinct(sample_id, 
           .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), 
                   ~ sum(is.na(.)))) |>
  select(where(~ . > 0))
```

```{r}
describe_df |>
  distinct(sample_id, 
           .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(Gender = factor(sex_at_birth),
         vital_status = factor(vital_status),
         eln_risk_classification = factor(eln_risk_classification)) |>
  table1(x = formula(~ Gender + eln_risk_classification | vital_status),
         data = _)
```

```{r}
describe_df |>
  distinct(sample_id, 
           .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(Gender = factor(sex_at_birth),
         vital_status = factor(vital_status),
         Age_group = cut(x = age_years, 
                         breaks = seq(from = 0,
                                      to = 100,
                                      by = 10))) |>
  droplevels() |>
  table1(x = formula(~ Gender + Age_group | vital_status),
         data = _)
```

```{r}
describe_df |> 
  distinct(sample_id, 
           .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(Age_group = cut(
    x = age_years,
    breaks = seq(from = 0,
                 to = 100,
                 by = 10))) |> 
  drop_na(vital_status, Age_group) |> 
  count(vital_status, Age_group) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = Age_group,
             y = n,
             fill = vital_status)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(
    preserve = "single"),
    colour = "black",
    alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(vjust = 5))
```

```{r}
describe_df |>
  distinct(sample_id, 
           .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(Gender = factor(sex_at_birth),
         vital_status = factor(vital_status),
         eln_risk_classification = factor(eln_risk_classification),
         race = factor(race)) |>
  table1(x = formula(~ vital_status + eln_risk_classification + race | Gender),
         data = _)
```

```{r}
describe_df |> 
  distinct(sample_id, 
           .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  drop_na(eln_risk_classification) |> 
  count(vital_status, eln_risk_classification) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = eln_risk_classification,
             y = n,
             fill = vital_status)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(
    preserve = "single"),
    colour = "black",
    alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(vjust = 5))
```

```{r}
describe_df |>
  distinct(sample_id, vital_status) |>
ggplot(aes(x = vital_status)) +
  geom_bar()
```

```{r}
describe_df |>
  distinct(sample_id, sample_type) |>
  count(sample_type) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(sample_type, n),
           y = n)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip()
```
